events.title: Puppy Yoga
events.description: A one-hour guided yoga class, then an hour of puppy cuddles, play and socializing. Hosted with Purely Paws Yoga. All ages welcome; every guest needs a ticket, and members can buy tickets for their guests.
events.image_alt: A yoga instructor in a standing split above a Bernese mountain dog puppy lying on her mat in the Den 1880 theatre
